connector.name: Compeller
connector.registryDescription: Create and track AI music videos and audio-reactive visuals from songs.
connector.summary: Hosted at compeller.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.compeller. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from Compeller Account → API Access, POST /api/login, or POST /api/v1/auth/token. Discovery tools work without this header; generation/account tools require it.

headers.name: X-API-Token
headers.description: Alternative Compeller API token header. Use this instead of Authorization if your MCP client stores token values without the Bearer prefix.
